thesisQuality.basis: Durable crop-protection need and proprietary pipeline are credible, but durable economic capture is unproven while legacy products erode.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Revenue -17%, organic revenue -22%, EBITDA -26%, EPS -62%, lowered full-year outlook and high leverage outweigh transaction-aided cash generation.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: $10.28 share price and ~$1.29B market cap imply depressed expectations versus $3.25B TTM revenue, but leverage and dilution constrain asymmetry.

catalystScore.basis: Debt-reduction transactions and expected Q4 return to growth are identifiable catalysts, but several remain conditional or forward expectations.

governancePower.basis: Management executed financing/portfolio actions and disclosed tradeoffs, but major dilution, restructuring and weak operating results keep stewardship evidence mixed.

alignment2036.basis: Crop yield and pest control are durable agricultural needs, with new active ingredients providing credible long-duration relevance.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Global crop-protection portfolio spans insecticides, herbicides and fungicides across regions, but remains concentrated in agricultural inputs.

bottleneckControl.basis: Proprietary actives provide differentiated capability, but generic/post-patent competition and alternatives show limited control of an enduring system bottleneck.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Global agricultural need supports demand, but leverage, grower economics, channel timing and legacy-product erosion leave material scenario dependence.

substitutionResilience.basis: New active ingredients and R&D support adaptation, while generic and alternative crop-protection approaches create substantial substitution pressure.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Global operations provide some diversification, but available evidence does not demonstrate exceptional multi-source redundancy; unknowns are treated conservatively.

pricingPower.basis: Current legacy-product price pressure is direct evidence of weak near-term pricing power despite differentiated products.

riskEvidence.basis: High leverage, weak recurring earnings, conditional deleveraging transactions and ~20% equity dilution create elevated but not thesis-terminal risk.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Fresh issuer Q2 results, transaction disclosure and SEC-indexed quarterly data support core facts; valuation is independently current, while supplier concentration and new-active economics remain incompletely disclosed.

scoreRecord.thesis: FMC serves durable crop-protection needs and has a credible proprietary renewal pipeline, but current value depends on successful deleveraging and new actives offsetting severe legacy-product erosion.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: Operating deterioration and generic/price pressure persist faster than portfolio renewal while leverage and dilution reduce resilience.
scoreRecord.nextCatalyst: Closing of announced deleveraging transactions and Q4 2026 evidence for or against management's expected return to year-over-year growth.

scoreBreakdown.note: Weighted Methodology 1.0 component score before separate risk/confidence gating; risk and confidence are reported explicitly and not double-counted without a locked formula authorizing an adjustment.
